subject: SparkBridge renewal: commit rebalance & per-token ceiling proposal
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@sparkbridge.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — proposal to rebalance commit and add per-token ceiling

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the candid usage data during the renewal call. Based on Q2/Q3 trends we saw sustained spikes in short-chat traffic driven by your in-app onboarding flows; you’re also seeing a lower-than-expected steady-state for long-form batch jobs.

Rather than move you to a larger flat commit, we propose: 1) rebalance the renewal commit to shift 60% of the capacity into a higher-frequency per-token tier (for chat-level traffic) and 40% into a reserved slab for long-form jobs; 2) add a per-token ceiling (anchored discount) so that if monthly spend growth exceeds 15% month-over-month we cap the per-token discount escalation while keeping unit economics predictable for both sides.

High-level numbers attached — I can walk through them in a 30-min sync next week. Would Tue 9/14 10am PT work?

Thanks,
Sergio
Enterprise Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SparkBridge_MA_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal), usage_report_q2.csv (usage by endpoint)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@sparkbridge.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@sparkbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — proposal to rebalance commit and add per-token ceiling

Sergio —

Appreciate the write-up. A couple quick responses:
- The team is comfortable rebalancing the mix, but finance wants clarity on the "per-token ceiling" behavior. If you cap discount escalation, how will overage be invoiced? We need predictable budget guidance for Q4.
- Procurement flagged internal policy: any renewal uplift over 12% requires VP approval. Can you model scenarios with 0%, 10% and 12% uplift bands?

We can do Tue 9/14 10am PT. I'll loop in legal if we move toward contract language.

Emily
Head of Platform
SparkBridge
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@sparkbridge.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — proposal to rebalance commit and add per-token ceiling

Emily — thanks for the quick reply and for surfacing procurement thresholds.

In the call I walked Emily and procurement through a simple billing table (attached). Short version:
- Overage charges beyond the anchored ceiling are billed at the standard hosted per-token rate (no retroactive price jumps); discounts above the ceiling stop applying for the overage portion only.
- We can supply an SLO credit mechanism for sudden sustained spikes during a migration window (one-off relief if we see a documented launch).

Monica/Aditya — can you confirm the three uplift scenarios (0/10/12%) and produce an exportable table for Emily before EOD tomorrow? We'll attach to the contract addendum.

Sergio
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — proposal to rebalance commit and add per-token ceiling

Sergio/Aditya —

Attached are three scenarios (0pct_uplift.csv, 10pct_uplift.csv, 12pct_uplift.csv) plus the blended per-token cost table. Summary:
- 0% uplift: no change to current effective blended rate; commit reallocation reduces variance but yields no price concessions.
- 10% uplift: effective per-token discount improves by ~6% for chat-tier, long-form slab unchanged.
- 12% uplift: discount improvement ~7.5% on chat-tier; procurement threshold reached and will need VP sign-off.

I also added language for the addendum that explicitly caps discount escalation at 15% in any single month and offers a single-month overage grace if tied to a documented product launch.

Let me know if you want this baked into the proposal PDF. I can also generate the invoice line examples for legal review.

Monica
Sr. Pricing Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SparkBridge_proposal_scenarios.zip (contains CSVs)
From: Anna Rosen <anna.rosen@rrosenlaw.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@sparkbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — proposal to rebalance commit and add per-token ceiling

Forwarding legal comment: please see inline edits to paragraph 4 of the addendum. Key ask: replace "cap" language with "temporary adjustment mechanism subject to prior written notice and documented metrics" and add a 30-day notice period for any retroactive pricing adjustments.

On Thu, Sep 16, 2027 at 14:45 Emily Chen <emily.chen@sparkbridge.ai> wrote:
> Sergio —
> 
> Legal wants the notice window and clearer metrics. Procurement is also confirming internal VP approval timelines; they asked if Redwood can commit to 7 business days for issuing a contract addendum once uplift band is chosen.
> 
> Emily

Anna Rosen

Rosen & Partners
